    return 0.5 * float(abs(np.sum(H * np.roll(B, -1) - np.roll(H, -1) * B)))

def intrinsic_loop(Bmax, nseg=300):
    st = mat.state0()[None, :].copy()
    Bseq = np.concatenate([np.linspace(0, Bmax, nseg), np.linspace(Bmax, -Bmax, 2*nseg),
